item.title: This Gorgeous 'Stop-Motion' Adventure Swims Onto Switch 2 Next Month

description.p: The name's Halibut, Harold Halibut.Harold Halibut released back in 2024 with one of those visual styles that immediately made us sit up and pay attention. item.title: Kotaro Uchikoshi, Creator Of Zero Escape And AI: The Somnium Files, Launches New Studio

description.p: It's currently seeking investment for original projects.Kotaro Uchikoshi, the creator behind IP such as Zero Escape and AI: The Somnium Files, has launched a new development studio called Crash Keys and is serving as its representative director and CEO.It's early days yet (sort of – keep reading), but the studio is looking to create original projects "unbound by conventional formulas" and is currently seeking investment partners to help bring its vision to life. item.title: RedLynx, The Studio Behind The Trials Series, Is Being Closed By Ubisoft

description.p: Another one bites the dust.If you were around during the height of the 'Xbox Live Arcade' initiative, then you might have played a little game called Trials HD. It was a big part of the second 'Summer of Arcade' event when it launched in 2009, garnering positive reception and helping Finnish developer RedLynx produce several sequels, including Trials Evolution, Trials Fusion, and Trials Rising. Nintendo fans only received the latter entry on Switch, but the entire series is well worth playing, if you can.Unfortunately, Ubisoft – having acquired RedLynx back in 2011 – has now proposed to close the studio down entirely as part of its ongoing restructuring (thanks, GamesIndustry). In a statement, the firm said:Read the full article on nintendolife.com
